name: Avista Hideaway Patong Resort & Spa Phuket
short_description: A 150-room MGallery boutique resort in the hills above Patong with three pools, a Michelin Guide-featured restaurant, and 12 pool villas.
ai_summary: Avista Hideaway Patong Resort & Spa Phuket is a 150-room MGallery Collection boutique resort nestled in landscaped hills above Patong, designed for couples and families wanting seclusion just minutes from the beach and nightlife rather than a central Patong stay. Thai-inspired accommodations cascade through the gardens, including 12 recently renovated pool villas, alongside three pools each with a swim-up bar, a spa with outdoor cabanas, rooftop mini-golf, a kids club, and a Michelin Guide-featured rooftop restaurant. Guest reviews are strongly positive, repeatedly calling it a standout Phuket property with spotless facilities, an excellent breakfast buffet, and attentive service, though a subset of reviews note that some rooms and shared areas don't fully match the marketing photos.

faqs.question: Does Avista Hideaway Patong Resort & Spa Phuket have pool villas?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside 150 Thai-inspired rooms cascading through landscaped hillside gardens, the resort has 12 recently renovated pool villas, giving guests a private-pool option within the same MGallery Collection property above Patong.

faqs.question: Is Avista Hideaway Patong close to the beach?
faqs.answer: It's set in the hills just minutes from Patong's beach and nightlife rather than directly on the sand, trading immediate beach access for a quieter, garden-set resort with three pools, a spa, and Michelin Guide-featured dining.
